description: US federal refund estimate for tax year 2026 (filed Jan-Apr 2027): W-2 federal withholding minus tax after the 2026 standard deduction ($16,100 single, $32,200 MFJ, $24,150 HOH, +$1,650/$2,050 per 65+/blind) and brackets, and the child tax credit ($2,200 a child, up to $1,700 refundable at 15% of earned income over $2,500, phased out by $50 per $1,000 over $200,000/$400,000). Source: Rev. Proc. 2025-32, IRC §24. State tax, EITC, itemized deductions and the tips/overtime/senior deductions are not included. US, as of 2026-11-23 (official sources). General estimate only: not tax advice, no return preparation or filing. Items listed as not included were not verified and are not added.
